task: The base cert (docs/MECHANISM_TMR_RPNI_REINNERVATION.md) established rank(M_new) <= K, K~=3-9 surgically-created EMG readout sites, peak 3 simultaneous continuous DOF vs a ~23-DOF hand -- a real, quantified ceiling. Operator directive: innovate PAST this ceiling, not accept it. This cert attacks K from BOTH ends: RAISE K (micro-RPNI/one-per-fascicle, HD-sEMG motor-unit decomposition, intrafascicular electrode arrays) and LOWER the required rank (hand postural synergies, shared-autonomy/vision-assisted control). Forced adversary, held symmetric: (a) do raised channel counts stay INDEPENDENT at scale or does crosstalk/common-drive collapse effective rank back down; (b) does synergy-based control deliver naturalistic function in REAL amputees or only offline variance-explained; (c) does shared-autonomy help real task outcomes or add cost. If the combination does NOT clearly exceed the ~3-DOF ceiling in DEMONSTRATED real-amputee function, say so as first-class.
note_on_deliverable_type: Literature-synthesis falsifier, companion to docs/MECHANISM_TMR_RPNI_REINNERVATION.md. One arithmetic/gates script (scripts/msk/decode_channel_ceiling_gates.py, ~230 lines) machine-computes ratios/PASS-FAIL from numbers transcribed verbatim from primary sources -- no new EMG/twin simulation this session. WebSearch was session-quota-exhausted before this task began (fleet-wide budget, confirmed at task start) -- every citation below was resolved via direct NCBI eutils (esearch->esummary->efetch) and, where the abstract lacked the needed number, a WebFetch of the cited PMC full text or publisher/aggregator page, disclosed per-row.
determinism_check: two invocations of the gates script produce byte-identical JSON (md5 matched this session) -- pure arithmetic on fixed literature-derived constants, no randomness, no external data dependency at run time.
confidence_tier: TIERED, not a single yes/no. RAISE-K(fascicle/micro-RPNI): anatomical budget is NOT binding (PASS, gate_R1a) but the one paper with the opportunity to test fascicle-splitting found only 2 distinct commands among 4 median-nerve RPNIs, and never quantified independence in its highest-K patients (FAIL, gate_R1b, disclosed). RAISE-K(MU decomposition): decomposability (11-19/muscle) is NOT the bottleneck but independent volitional control (3/muscle, able-bodied, non-hand muscle, 6 days training) falls far short of it, consistent with the common-drive mechanism (FAIL, gate_R2, disclosed, matches theory). RAISE-K(intrafascicular arrays): PASSES the base cert's 3-DOF ceiling -- 5-DOF rigorously-independent real-time control via 2 chronic 100-ch USEAs in 2 real amputees (PASS, gate_R3a/gate_FINAL_a), though short-duration and research-grade. LOWER-RANK(synergies): 3 PCs->90% variance for STATIC grasp-shaping (PASS, gate_S1) does NOT generalize to natural continuous use, where the same PC count reaches only 60% (FAIL, gate_S2, disclosed) -- and dynamic manipulation needs strictly more synergies than grasping, task-dependently. LOWER-RANK(shared autonomy): real functional gain in real amputees (88% task success, n=2, PASS gate_SA1) but on a DIFFERENT axis (task success via fixed grasp-class selection, not independent-DOF count) -- disclosed, not conflated. SYNTHESIS: K_eff(best real, rigorous)=5 covers the verified STATIC synergy floor (3) with margin (PASS gate_SYN1), and 5>3 breaks the base cert's ceiling in a decorrelated method class (PASS gate_FINAL_a) -- but no study combines raised-K + synergy-remapping + shared-autonomy, nor demonstrates DURABLE, naturalistic function at the raised count (FAIL gate_FINAL_b, pre-registered, disclosed as the honest headline gap).

gates_summary: See reports/probes/decode_channel_ceiling_gates_results.json for the full machine-computed object. Headline: 11 gate_* checks, 7 PASS / 4 FAIL (not a clean sweep either direction -- symmetric QC per this project's own convention). Failing gates, all pre-registered to plausibly fail and disclosed as first-class findings, not hidden: gate_R1b (fascicle-split independence not proportional, 2/4 distinct commands), gate_R2 (MU volitional independence not proportional to decomposition yield, 3/14), gate_S2 (static-posture low-rank basis does not generalize to natural use, 60%<80%), gate_FINAL_b (no study demonstrates durable, integrated, naturalistic function at a raised DOF count).
symmetric_qc_open_items: the P1-median-RPNI redundancy finding (2 distinct commands from 4 fascicle-derived RPNIs) is n=1 patient, qualitative ultrasound observation, not a quantified correlation/cross-talk metric -- the paper itself did not compute one; this cert's 'gate_R1b FAILS' conclusion rests on that one qualitative quote, disclosed as thin evidence, not overstated as a proven redundancy law

Formento 2021's 3-independent-MU ceiling is in the biceps brachii of able-bodied subjects, NOT a hand muscle and NOT an amputee's reinnervated RPNI target -- applying it to the RPNI raise-K leg is an explicit EXTRAPOLATION across both muscle-type and patient-population, flagged in the gates script (flag_R2) and named as the natural next experiment, not asserted as already measured

Wendelken 2017's headline 'up to 12 DOF' and Davis 2016's '13 movements decoded offline' are BOTH real, reported numbers -- but this cert treats them as inflated relative to the rigorously-independence-validated numbers (5 DOF; 2 movements online) from the SAME papers, a judgment call this cert makes explicit (flag_R3b/flag_R3c) rather than silently picking the bigger number

the synergy-dimensionality comparison (Santello 90% at 3 PCs vs Ingram 60% at 2 PCs) is not a perfectly matched apples-to-apples comparison: different PC counts (3 vs 2), different DOF instrumented (15 joint angles vs an unspecified-in-the-abstract glove DOF count), different task (static posture-shaping snapshot vs continuous unconstrained recording) -- disclosed as a genuine, honest limitation of the comparison, not smoothed into one clean number

the operator's proposed '~5-6-D synergy space' and '~8-12 real channels' framing is DIRECTIONALLY consistent with this session's verified numbers (3 PCs=90% static floor; Vu2020 P1/P2 = 8-9 RPNIs; Wendelken informal ceiling = 12) but neither exact figure was itself independently pinned to one live citation this session -- reported as a plausible, literature-consistent range, not a verified constant, matching this project's own disclosed-convention pattern for the base cert's D=23 hand-DOF figure

Zhuang 2019's exact quantitative results were not independently re-extracted this session (EPFL infoscience rate-limited HTTP 429 twice, Nature's page behind an auth redirect) -- existence, authorship, venue, DOI, and the abstract's own qualitative claims ARE confirmed via 2 independent routes (Crossref + Semantic Scholar), but no percentage from this paper is asserted as a specific number anywhere in this cert

no dedicated study on shared-autonomy DOWNSIDES (added latency, misclassification cost, user trust/frustration) was found this session -- 2 targeted esearch queries for this exact adversary returned zero PubMed hits; the honest substitute adversary used instead is the SCOPE limits of the 2 positive studies found (Markovic 2014: healthy subjects only; Ghazaei 2017: n=2, 4 grasp classes only, lab conditions) -- disclosed as a real gap in the corpus, not papered over with a forced citation

this is a literature-synthesis falsifier, not a physical simulation -- like its companion base cert, every number is a reported clinical/experimental result; the 'machine gate' computes threshold comparisons on those literal numbers (the determinism check covers the ARITHMETIC, not a re-measurement of the underlying biology)
